claims.text: MOA: inhibits bact RNA and protein synth.
claims.quote: Mupirocin inhibits bacterial RNA and protein synthesis.

claims.text: Treats: topical only; bactericidal vs staph and beta-hemolytic strep; negligible systemic absorb.
claims.quote: It is available only as a 2% topical preparation, which is bactericidal against staphylococci and beta-hemolytic streptococci. Systemic absorption of topical mupirocin is negligible.

claims.text: Know: impetigo, minor secondarily infected skin lesions, eradication of S. aureus nasal carriage (relapse common).
claims.quote: Mupirocin is used for Impetigo Minor superficial secondarily infected skin lesions Eradication of Staphylococcus aureus nasal carriage, although relapse rates may be high

claims.text: Caution: chronic use selects mupirocin-resistant staph; itching/burning on denuded skin or mucosa.
claims.quote: Chronic therapy leads to mupirocin-resistant staphylococci. Mupirocin is nontoxic but, when applied to denuded skin or mucous membranes, may cause itching and burning.
